say:1:1820506001:0.source_cn: 咦，怎么只有你们两个人？瑟恩呢？

say:2:1820506002:0.source_cn: 他去巡逻了，让我们两人先休息。

say:3:1820506003:0.text: I agree with him on that. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you need plenty of rest to fully recover from your afterlife vertigo.

say:4:1820506004:0.text: Same goes for you, Estrilda! Baba said your infection was more serious, so don't push yourself too hard.
say:4:1820506004:0.source_cn: 还有爱丝！婆婆说你感染赤烛蕊的时间更长，本来就恢复得比...

say:5:1820506005:0.text: Don't worry about me, Ba—I mean, Rain.
say:5:1820506005:0.source_cn: 没关系，巴……里纳。我已经习惯了。

say:6:1820506006:0.text: How can I not worry? Humans get tired, hurt, and sick so easily. You can't just replace your body parts like the Graveborn, so you'd better start taking care of yourself!
say:6:1820506006:0.source_cn: 这怎么能习惯？生者会疲倦、受伤或是生病，还不像亡灵那样...

say:8:1820506008:0.text: A slightly wiser one, though. If I were surrounded by enemies, I wouldn't have pressed on as you did.
say:8:1820506008:0.source_cn: 我又不会像你那样，不顾一切地往敌人堆里扎。

say:9:1820506009:0.text: ...And who do you think I picked that up from?

say:10:1820506010:0.text: Enough about me already. Look, I'm thinking of pulling a prank on Thane. Want to join me?
say:10:1820506010:0.source_cn: 不说这个了，你要不要和我一起去捉弄瑟恩？

say:12:1820506012:0.text: I promised to help you remember your past, didn't I? I think doing things we used to do together might help.
say:12:1820506012:0.source_cn: 我不是说过要帮你找回记忆吗？也许带你重温一遍我们做过的...

say:13:1820506013:0.text: Um... but Thane and I aren't that close.
say:13:1820506013:0.source_cn: 呃……可我才刚认识瑟恩没多久，这不太好吧？

say:14:1820506014:0.text: Besides, he has a short fuse and always looks so stern... Honestly, he kind of scares me.
say:14:1820506014:0.source_cn: 而且他的脾气也不好，总是绷着脸，一言不发地瞪着我……看...

say:15:1820506015:0.text: But you used to mess with Thane all the time... Just do it as a favor to me. I've been wanting to get back at him.
say:15:1820506015:0.source_cn: 但这是你以前最喜欢做的事……要不然，就当是帮我出气吧？

say:16:1820506016:0.source_cn: 出气？瑟恩他竟然欺负你吗？！

say:17:1820506017:0.text:
... No, not really! He takes good care of me, actually.
He's just way too strict when he's teaching me swordsmanship.
say:17:1820506017:0.source_cn: ——没有没有！他很照顾我！\n只不过作为剑术老师，他的...

say:18:1820506018:0.text: Once, he made me train late into the night until I finally fixed my slow movements!
say:18:1820506018:0.source_cn: 之前他说我出手速度太慢，非要我练好了才准休息，到了半夜...

say:19:1820506019:0.text: That's too much! Fine, I'll help you. I'm not too fond of him either!
say:19:1820506019:0.source_cn: 这也太过分了！好，我帮你去教训他！我早就看他不顺眼了！

say:22:1820506021:0.text: So what's your plan, Estrilda? And where do I come in?

say:23:1820506022:0.text: First, we'll carve a scary face into a pumpkin, stick a couple of branches into the sides, and wrap it in some rags to make it look like a ghost.

say:24:1820506023:0.text: Then, I need your help hanging it from a tree while I lure Thane over.

say:25:1820506024:0.text: Once he's in the right spot, yank the rope and let it swing down behind him. That ought to give him a good scare!
